summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by LightInTheBox Holding Co., Ltd. announcing the appointment of Dr. Cheng Chen as an independent director, effective June 22, 2026, and his membership on the audit, compensation, and governance committees. The disclosure includes standard biographical details and confirms no material transactions or arrangements. This is a routine board appointment with no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, or activist campaign. Accordingly, this filing does not constitute a special situation.
